Snapshot each value min/max nonnegative strict integer bounds; simultaneously enforce per-value counts, using assigned counts and remaining-domain support as safe necessary pruning conditions. closed=True excludes unlisted values; closed=False allows them. Do not confuse one combined SomeInSet count with independent bounds. Reject repeated variables and invalid bound shapes/ranges; impossible but structurally legal bounds produce no solutions. Forward checking must preserve every brute-force legal assignment across solver modes; unary preprocessing must preserve the earlier declared-domain isolation. Document that this is safe support pruning, not a claim of complete generalized arc consistency.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.
